verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents a programmatic API: server-side `auth.api` methods, typed client methods such as `authClient.signUp.email`, plugin endpoints for JWT/JWKS, admin operations and API key management, all in machine-readable docs. However, probes found no OpenAPI spec. A community user reports virtually no documentation for building a non-JS client against the HTTP API, and another says the request-header-based design makes admin scripts and tests hacky. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI or REST reference for the HTTP endpoints, documentation for non-JS clients, clean headless and scripted invocation.
